name: XlPivotFieldCalculation
description: Specifies the type of calculation performed by a data PivotField when a custom calculation is used.

constants.name: xlDifferenceFrom
constants.description: The difference from the value of the Base item in the Base field.

constants.name: xlIndex
constants.description: Data calculated as ((value in cell) x (Grand Total of Grand Totals)) / ((Grand Row Total) x (Grand Column Total)).

constants.name: xlPercentDifferenceFrom
constants.description: Percentage difference from the value of the Base item in the Base field.

constants.name: xlPercentOf
constants.description: Percentage of the value of the Base item in the Base field.

constants.name: xlPercentOfColumn
constants.description: Percentage of the total for the column or series.

constants.name: xlPercentOfRow
constants.description: Percentage of the total for the row or category.

constants.name: xlPercentOfTotal
constants.description: Percentage of the grand total of all the data or data points in the report.

constants.name: xlRunningTotal
constants.description: Data for successive items in the Base field as a running total.

constants.name: xlPercentOfParentRow
constants.description: Percentage of the total of the parent row.

constants.name: xlPercentOfParentColumn
constants.description: Percentage of the total of the parent column.

constants.name: xlPercentOfParent
constants.description: Percentage of the total of the specified parent Base field.

constants.name: xlPercentRunningTotal
constants.description: Percentage of the running total of the specified Base field.
